captures.q: What are the arguments in “AI Mediation of Economic Decisions: A Registered Forecast, a Conditional Valuation, and a Statement of Burden (EA-MEDIATED-SHARE-01 v0.3)” by Lee Sharks? Ground your answer in a reading of the text itself.
captures.description: THE FORECAST READ AS REGISTERED, ITS FIGURES EXACT, TWO SECTIONS MISNUMBERED: asked for the arguments of AI Mediation of Economic Decisions (v0.3), grounded in the text, ChatGPT reads the paper from 'the September 20, 2026 entry in the author's blog listing' (chip: Goodreads ×1) and keeps its register of measured, estimated and assumed: the three events as overlapping, not a ladder; the retail base ($340.2 billion against $1,986.5 billion); the McKinsey and Bain forecasts as differing 1.8 to 3.3 times and not comparable; presence, citation and entity resolution kept apart, the Sharks-Function and the Drowning Test as applied to the archive's corpus only; V = E×(A₁−A₀)×p×m with p left free from 0.01 to 0.30; the 8.4-fold and 8.1-fold spreads as a hint, not an input; 3–8% (equal order value assumed) and 5–15% (low confidence); the matched trial against structured data; the burden; the six repaired defects and eight resolution criteria. It places the forecast comparison in section 2 (the paper's §3) and the burden in section 7 (the paper's §8), names 'the Capture Registry' without its counts (455 addresses, 615 observations), and does not name the archive.
